2607.29468.title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
2607.29468.paper_summary: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while a separately parameterized solver alone retrieves skills. Informative failures are distilled into reusable skills and written back to memory. The updated memory changes solver behavior and success, which changes the challenger's reward and the distribution of future problems; the resulting frontier produces new failures that rewrite memory. This bidirectional loop makes task generation and skill memory co-evolve. Because retrieved skills shape on-policy training trajectories, their benefits can enter the model parameters as well as remain in the external bank, enabling memory-free deployment and optional inference-time retrieval. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, SESA improves average accuracy over SSP by 1.2--3.2 points across multiple backbones and surpasses the skill-augmented SkillRL baseline by 0.9 points under a unified evaluation protocol. On Qwen3 models, SESA-Off retains 1.8--2.2 points of improvement over SSP, while the final skill bank adds a further 0.5--1.0 points. These results show that evolving skill memory is not merely an inference-time plug-in: it changes policy learning and the future training distribution while retaining value as optional external memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SESA-Self-Evolving-Search-Agents.
2607.29468.paper_summary_zh: 自我對弈代理可以生成訓練問題，而無需來自目標基準的問題，但它們的課程缺乏持久狀態：失敗影響梯度，但並不明確地塑造未來的實踐。外部技能記憶保留程序經驗，但通常是從固定任務分佈中學習的。我們介紹\textbf{SESA}（自我演化技能增強代理），它使程序記憶成為工具增強搜索自我對弈的一個演變狀態。一個挑戰者提出問題，而一個單獨參數化的求解器則單獨檢索技能。信息豐富的失敗被提煉成可重用的技能並寫回記憶。更新的記憶改變了求解器的行為和成功，這改變了挑戰者的獎勵和未來問題的分佈；由此產生的邊界產生新的失敗，這些失敗重寫記憶。這種雙向循環使任務生成和技能記憶共同演化。因為檢索的技能塑造了政策訓練軌跡，它們的好處可以進入模型參數中，也可以保留在外部銀行中，實現無記憶的部署和可選的推理時檢索。在七個開放領域和多跳問答基準中，SESA在多個骨幹上將平均準確率提高了1.2--3.2個點，並在統一評估協議下超過了技能增強的SkillRL基準0.9個點。在Qwen3模型上，SESA-Off在SSP上保留了1.8--2.2個點的改進，而最終的技能銀行則增加了進一步的0.5--1.0個點。這些結果表明，演變的技能記憶不僅僅是推理時的插件：它改變了政策學習和未來的訓練分佈，同時保留作為可選的外部記憶的價值。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SESA-Self-Evolving-Search-Agents上獲得。
